We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to target molecule C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2 reproduces Peterson reaction: forward: beta-hydroxy silane -> alkene, breaking C-Si and C-O, forming C=C. In retrosynthesis, we need to break C=C into C-O and C-Si (i.e., generate a beta-hydroxy silane precursor). So functional groups broken in forward: C-C double bond formed, carbon-silicon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken. In retrosynthesis, we need template that forms C-O and C-Si from alkene. So search criteria: functional_groups_broken (forward) = ["C-C double bonds"]? Actually forward forms C-C double bond, so broken groups are "ketones" and "trimethylsilyl". The description: "C-C double bonds formed, while 'ketones' and 'trimethylsilyl' groups are lost." So forward: broken functional groups: ketone, trimethylsilyl. Formed: C-C double bond. So we search with functional_groups_broken = ["ketones","trimethylsilyl"], functional_groups_formed = ["C-C double bonds"].

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with those.
